tasks_queue_consistency.value: "tasks"."queue_rank" IS NULL OR ("tasks"."queue_rationale" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."queue_ranked_at" IS NOT NULL)

public.v_eligible_for_prioritization.definition:
select "id", "title", "description", "status", "priority", "category", "owner", "due_date", "follow_up_date", "snoozed_until", "handoff_state", "handoff_copied_at", "handoff_last_copied_at", "handoff_last_nudge_copied_at", "goal_id", "created_at", "updated_at", "completed_at", "cancelled_at", "last_status_change_at", "last_unblocked_at", "needs_attention", "needs_attention_set_at", "needs_attention_reason", "embedding", "hard_deadline", "effort", "queue_rank", "queue_rationale", "queue_ranked_at" from "tasks" where "tasks"."status" IN ('triage', 'backlog', 'in_progress')
        OR ("tasks"."status" = 'blocked'
            AND "tasks"."last_unblocked_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND "tasks"."last_unblocked_at" >= now() - interval '24 hours')
public.v_eligible_for_prioritization.name: v_eligible_for_prioritization

public.v_recent_wins.definition: select "id", "title", "description", "status", "priority", "category", "owner", "due_date", "follow_up_date", "snoozed_until", "handoff_state", "handoff_copied_at", "handoff_last_copied_at", "handoff_last_nudge_copied_at", "goal_id", "created_at", "updated_at", "completed_at", "cancelled_at", "last_status_change_at", "last_unblocked_at", "needs_attention", "needs_attention_set_at", "needs_attention_reason", "embedding", "hard_deadline", "effort", "queue_rank", "queue_rationale", "queue_ranked_at" from "tasks" where "tasks"."status" = 'done' AND "tasks"."completed_at" >= now() - interval '7 days'
public.v_recent_wins.name: v_recent_wins
